public_messages.content: 接着刚才的结果，只看 SN 2014J 的视线 E(B−V)。选出三篇不同论文的原报测量，保留误差和条件，用表格和误差图比较，并结合本任务知识库解释它们是否能直接比较。再用 A_V=R_V E(B−V) 做一个可调 R_V 的示意试算，注明输入来自哪条测量，原文和知识依据都要能点开。试算固定使用其中一条已引用的 E(B−V)，R_V 范围 1–5、步长 0.1、初始值 3.1；明确这是演示参数，不是 SN 2014J 的科学采用值。

### 核心回答

从已交付的 55 条视线 $E(B-V)$ 记录 [DEF:prop-dot-r69b04-nt-sn-line-of-sight-ebv] 中，选出三篇不同论文的原报测量。它们的数值（1.22、0.45、0.71 mag）差异显著，**不能直接比较**：三者分别基于光变曲线拟合、消光+星周散射联合模型、以及弥散星际带 (DIB) 经验关系，物理含义与假设条件完全不同。下方表格、误差图与对比组件给出细节；末尾提供固定其中一条测量的可调 $R_V$ 示意试算。

### 三篇论文原报 E(B−V) 测量表

- 视线E(B−V)消光：1.22 ± 0.05 mag mag [REC:measurement-02f946c04042aec0207109863e91610815a88d018bf2212fbda637b093099b39]

- 视线E(B−V)消光：0.45 mag [REC:measurement-108a47ccbc25694a6faa13eb75622e88058e480d33b75c3fb251f932f5f4ac91]

- 视线E(B−V)消光：0.71±0.11 mag [REC:measurement-1615f1b0b6be7e3944e5846225704ef722052a79509c2c848a290220e163c452]

### E(B−V) 误差区间图

- 视线E(B−V)消光：1.22 ± 0.05 mag mag [REC:measurement-02f946c04042aec0207109863e91610815a88d018bf2212fbda637b093099b39]

- 视线E(B−V)消光：0.45 mag [REC:measurement-108a47ccbc25694a6faa13eb75622e88058e480d33b75c3fb251f932f5f4ac91]

- 视线E(B−V)消光：0.71±0.11 mag [REC:measurement-1615f1b0b6be7e3944e5846225704ef722052a79509c2c848a290220e163c452]

### 能否直接比较？——条件与方法对照

原报 $E(B-V)_{\rm host}=1.22\pm0.05$ mag。使用 SNooPy 光变曲线拟合器对极大前测光数据拟合，同时得到 $R_V=1.4\pm0.15$。该值代表宿主星系总色余，隐含 CCM 消光律假设。[SOURCE:work-27459bf6b0141bdf3fa0e170ad2415cce10093fc3037dcc85132ea8c5f28ba1a:p.3]

原报 $E(B-V)_{\rm true}=0.45$ mag（无独立误差）。采用 CSMD 联合模型：将 F99 红化 ($R_V=2.57$) 与星周介质 (CSM) 散射 ($p=-2.57$) 分离，0.45 mag 仅为「真实红化分量」，其余消光被归入散射。因此该值不是视线总色余。[SOURCE:work-af200983035c140946828a625e895a4a1a175e107bd0313ed44d068a2e17d7a6:p.11]

原报 $E(B-V)=0.71\pm0.11$ mag。通过 M82 视线方向多条 DIB 等值宽度，利用银河系经验关系预测并做残差修正后取平均。反映的是气体/尘埃柱密度示踪量，不依赖 SN 光度模型。[SOURCE:work-598717e8648749996e425f28efae971421d54696f26a1c4eccf2288f76c64154:p.23]

But this picture, with R<SUB>V</SUB> = 1.6 ± 0.2, is too simple to account for all observations. We combine 10 epochs (spanning a month) of HST/Space Telescope Imaging Spectrograph (STIS) ultraviolet through near-infrared spectroscopy with HST/Wide Field Camera 3 (WFC3), Katzman Automatic Imaging Telescope, and FanCam photometry from the optical to the infrared and nine epochs of high-resolution TRES (Tillinghast Reflection Echelle Spectrograph) spectroscopy to investigate the sources of extinction and reddening for SN 2014J. Our earliest detections start just hours after the fitted time of explosion. We use high-resolution optical spectroscopy to analyze the dense intervening material and do not detect any evolution in the resolved absorption features during the light curve rise. Of the 10 relatively strong DIBs considered here, 6 (including λ5780.5) have strengths within ±20% of the mean values seen in the local Galactic ISM, for comparable N(K I); 2 are weaker by 20%-45% and 2 (including λ5797.1) are stronger by 25%-40%. Weaker than \"expected\" DIBs (relative to N(K I), N(Na I), and E(B - V)) in some Galactic sight lines and toward several other extragalactic supernovae appear to be associated with strong CN absorption and/or significant molecular fractions. While the N(CH)/N(K I) and N(CN)/N(CH) ratios seen toward SN 2014J are similar to those found in the local Galactic ISM, the combination of high N(CH<SUP>+</SUP>)/N(CH) and high W(5797.1)/W(5780.5) ratios has not been seen elsewhere. The centroids of many of the M82 DIBs are shifted relative to the envelope of the K I profile—likely due to component-to-component variations in W(DIB)/N(K I) that may reflect the molecular content of the individual components. Comparisons of the column densities of the atomic and molecular species and the equivalent widths of the DIBs reveal both similarities and differences in relative abundances, compared to trends seen in the ISM of our Galaxy and the Magellanic Clouds. Of the 10 relatively strong DIBs considered here, 6 (including λ5780.5) have strengths within ±20% of the mean values seen in the local Galactic ISM, for comparable N(K I); 2 are weaker by 20%-45% and 2 (including λ5797.1) are stronger by 25%-40%. Weaker than \"expected\" DIBs (relative to N(K I), N(Na I), and E(B - V)) in some Galactic sight lines and toward several other extragalactic supernovae appear to be associated with strong CN absorption and/or significant molecular fractions. The centroids of many of the M82 DIBs are shifted relative to the envelope of the K I profile—likely due to component-to-component variations in W(DIB)/N(K I) that may reflect the molecular content of the individual components. public_messages.content:
### 核心回答

从已交付的 55 条视线 $E(B-V)$ 记录 [DEF:prop-dot-r69b04-nt-sn-line-of-sight-ebv] 中，选出三篇不同论文的原报测量。它们的数值（1.22、0.45、0.71 mag）差异显著，**不能直接比较**：三者分别基于光变曲线拟合、消光+星周散射联合模型、以及弥散星际带 (DIB) 经验关系，物理含义与假设条件完全不同。下方表格、误差图与对比组件给出细节；末尾提供固定其中一条测量的可调 $R_V$ 示意试算。

### 三篇论文原报 E(B−V) 测量表

- 视线E(B−V)消光：1.22 ± 0.05 mag mag [REC:measurement-02f946c04042aec0207109863e91610815a88d018bf2212fbda637b093099b39]

- 视线E(B−V)消光：0.45 mag [REC:measurement-108a47ccbc25694a6faa13eb75622e88058e480d33b75c3fb251f932f5f4ac91]

- 视线E(B−V)消光：0.71±0.11 mag [REC:measurement-1615f1b0b6be7e3944e5846225704ef722052a79509c2c848a290220e163c452]

### E(B−V) 误差区间图

- 视线E(B−V)消光：1.22 ± 0.05 mag mag [REC:measurement-02f946c04042aec0207109863e91610815a88d018bf2212fbda637b093099b39]

- 视线E(B−V)消光：0.45 mag [REC:measurement-108a47ccbc25694a6faa13eb75622e88058e480d33b75c3fb251f932f5f4ac91]

- 视线E(B−V)消光：0.71±0.11 mag [REC:measurement-1615f1b0b6be7e3944e5846225704ef722052a79509c2c848a290220e163c452]

### 能否直接比较？——条件与方法对照

原报 $E(B-V)_{\rm host}=1.22\pm0.05$ mag。使用 SNooPy 光变曲线拟合器对极大前测光数据拟合，同时得到 $R_V=1.4\pm0.15$。该值代表宿主星系总色余，隐含 CCM 消光律假设。[SOURCE:work-27459bf6b0141bdf3fa0e170ad2415cce10093fc3037dcc85132ea8c5f28ba1a:p.3]

原报 $E(B-V)_{\rm true}=0.45$ mag（无独立误差）。采用 CSMD 联合模型：将 F99 红化 ($R_V=2.57$) 与星周介质 (CSM) 散射 ($p=-2.57$) 分离，0.45 mag 仅为「真实红化分量」，其余消光被归入散射。因此该值不是视线总色余。[SOURCE:work-af200983035c140946828a625e895a4a1a175e107bd0313ed44d068a2e17d7a6:p.11]

原报 $E(B-V)=0.71\pm0.11$ mag。通过 M82 视线方向多条 DIB 等值宽度，利用银河系经验关系预测并做残差修正后取平均。反映的是气体/尘埃柱密度示踪量，不依赖 SN 光度模型。[SOURCE:work-598717e8648749996e425f28efae971421d54696f26a1c4eccf2288f76c64154:p.23]

### 知识依据与示意试算说明

根据消光理论，总视向消光 $A_V$、色余 $E(B-V)$ 与消光曲线参数 $R_V$ 满足关系 $R_V = A_V / E(B-V)$ [THEORY:kb-block-08b602abd75e19e176d351164d103a05225fe648baff64b35dd1b2fb29e2a191]。该理论明确指出，$R_V$ 的数值不能在未说明环境和曲线时固定为一个普适常数；前景屏幕消光曲线与整星系衰减曲线并非同一物理对象 [THEORY:kb-block-08b602abd75e19e176d351164d103a05225fe648baff64b35dd1b2fb29e2a191]。

对 SN 2014J 的测量给出宿主星系视线方向最佳拟合色余 $E(B-V)_{\rm host} = 1.22 \pm 0.05\;{\rm mag}$，该值由 SNooPy 光变曲线拟合器在极大亮度前的测光数据上获得，误差为对称统计不确定度 [REC:measurement-02f946c04042aec0207109863e91610815a88d018bf2212fbda637b093099b39]。

以下公式与试算仅用于演示：将上述测量的中心值 $E(B-V)=1.22\;{\rm mag}$ 固定，扫描不同 $R_V$ 假设下对应的 $A_V$。此处取 $R_V=3.1$ 纯粹是演示参数，**不是** SN 2014J 的科学采用值或文献结论。试算结果不可等同于实际测量或文献采用的消光值。

### 等价变形公式

$$
A_V = R_V \cdot E(B-V)
$$

### A_V 随 R_V 变化的示意试算

$$
A_V = R_V \times 1.22
$$

Of the 10 relatively strong DIBs considered here, 6 (including λ5780.5) have strengths within ±20% of the mean values seen in the local Galactic ISM, for comparable N(K I); 2 are weaker by 20%-45% and 2 (including λ5797.1) are stronger by 25%-40%. Weaker than \"expected\" DIBs (relative to N(K I), N(Na I), and E(B - V)) in some Galactic sight lines and toward several other extragalactic supernovae appear to be associated with strong CN absorption and/or significant molecular fractions. The centroids of many of the M82 DIBs are shifted relative to the envelope of the K I profile—likely due to component-to-component variations in W(DIB)/N(K I) that may reflect the molecular content of the individual components. The centroids of many of the M82 DIBs are shifted relative to the envelope of the K I profile—likely due to component-to-component variations in W(DIB)/N(K I) that may reflect the molecular content of the individual components. Comparisons of the column densities of the atomic and molecular species and the equivalent widths of the DIBs reveal both similarities and differences in relative abundances, compared to trends seen in the ISM of our Galaxy and the Magellanic Clouds. Of the 10 relatively strong DIBs considered here, 6 (including λ5780.5) have strengths within ±20% of the mean values seen in the local Galactic ISM, for comparable N(K I); 2 are weaker by 20%-45% and 2 (including λ5797.1) are stronger by 25%-40%. Weaker than \"expected\" DIBs (relative to N(K I), N(Na I), and E(B - V)) in some Galactic sight lines and toward several other extragalactic supernovae appear to be associated with strong CN absorption and/or significant molecular fractions. The centroids of many of the M82 DIBs are shifted relative to the envelope of the K I profile—likely due to component-to-component variations in W(DIB)/N(K I) that may reflect the molecular content of the individual components.
